Click here for today's Connections hints, as well as our daily answers and hints for The New York Times Mini Crossword, Wordle, Connections: Sports Edition and Strands puzzles.Well, happy April Fools' Day from the New York Times! Today's NYT Connections puzzle reminded me of the rebus puzzles my friends and I used to enjoy solving as kids. They're puzzles that combine pictures and letters and placement to make you guess a word or phrase, like if you type the word HEAD over the word HEELS to create the common phrase, "head over heels." Read on for clues and today's Connections answers.The Times has a Connections Bot, like the one for Wordle. Go there after you play to receive a numeric score and to have the program analyze your answers. Players who are registered with the Times Games section can now nerd out by following their progress, including the number of puzzles completed, win rate, number of times they nabbed a perfect score and their win streak.Read more: Hints, Tips and Strategies to Help You Win at NYT Connections Every TimeHints for today's Connections groupsHere are four hints for the groupings in today's Connections puzzle, ranked from the easiest yellow group to the tough (and sometimes bizarre) purple group.Yellow group hint: Cheers!Green group hint: Rock out!Blue group hint: Enjoy the show.Purple group hint: Windy City is another one.Answers for today's Connections groupsYellow group: Beer brands.Green group: Rock bands.Blue group: Movies.Purple group: U.S. city nicknames.Read more: Wordle Cheat Sheet: Here Are the Most Popular Letters Used in English WordsWhat are today's Connections answers?In case you need to see those rebus puzzles again, here they are.
